fact: South Africa's WCO ESA country report for April 2025 to March 2026 says SARS continues SACU customs connectivity work matching import and export declarations by Unique Consignment Reference, notes partner system outages affecting cross-border data exchange, and says the Single Window portal and OGA inspection workflow are initiated with agriculture partners.
title: WORLD CUSTOMS ORGANIZATION, EAST & SOUTHERN AFRICA REGION: Country/Member Reporting Format, South Africa, April 2025 to March 2026
publisher: SARS for the WCO East and Southern Africa Regional Office for Capacity Building
